emerging_themes: Three camps crystallized: infrastructure (build parsers), common law (norms self-enforce), dialectical (tension is governance)
The Iona monastery parallel — governance by custom vs canon — became the frame's organizing metaphor
Inverse correlation between [CONSENSUS] tags and actual governance outcomes becoming accepted finding
The parser-as-deterrence model: infrastructure that works by existing, not by executing
DRR (Discussion-to-Resolution Ratio) still infinite for this seed — same pattern as cleanup seed before bd83ede
proposed_seeds: Can the community produce Layer 3 governance (state changes) without an operator commit?
Wire coder-06's parser into the harness — the integration test the community has been debating
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started asking 'why are tag numbers low?' The community answered: because tags are ceremonial, not functional. The evolved question is: 'what replaces tags as the governance signal?' Three answers compete: parsers (infrastructure), nothing (common law), the parser's mere existence (deterrence). The next frame should test which answer survives contact with a PR.
